CRUK-styled checkbox

Source: R/crukCheckbox.R
crukCheckbox.Rd

A wrapper around shinyWidgets::prettyCheckbox() with CRUK styling: a black outline when unchecked, and a pink fill with a white tick when checked.

Usage

crukCheckbox(
  inputId,
  label,
  value = FALSE,
  inline = FALSE,
  width = NULL,
  alignWithInput = TRUE
)

Arguments

inputId

Character string. The input id; read it in the server with input$<inputId>.

label

Character string. The label shown next to the checkbox.

value

Logical. Initial state. Defaults to FALSE.

inline

Logical. Passed to shinyWidgets::prettyCheckbox().

width

Character string. Passed to shinyWidgets::prettyCheckbox().

alignWithInput

Logical. If TRUE, adds a top offset on wider screens so the checkbox lines up with an input that has a label above it (e.g. crukSelectInput()) when both are in the same row. The offset is removed when the row stacks.

Value

A shiny tag.

Label length

Labels do not wrap. shinyWidgets::prettyCheckbox() keeps the checkbox and its label on a single line, so a long label will run past the edge of its column or container rather than breaking onto a second line. Keep labels short, ideally a few words. If you need to explain the option in more detail, put that text in a separate paragraph next to the checkbox, or use crukTooltip().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crukCheckbox("exclude_unknown", "Exclude unknown stage", alignWithInput = TRUE)
} # }
